<style>
  /* remove excess padding */
@media (min-width: 800px) {
    .fullwidth-text-block .container {
        padding-top: 45px;
    }
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
    .fullwidth-media {
        padding-top: 50px;
        padding-bottom: 0px;
    }
}
.factoids {
    padding: 0 7%;
    padding-top: 50px;
    padding-bottom: 50px;
    max-width: 100%;
}
@media (min-width: 800px) {
    .image-gallery {
        padding-bottom: 70px;
        padding-top: 80px;
    }
}
/* end remove excess padding */


/* responsive fix for h1 */
@media (max-width: 500px) {
h1, .h1 {
    font-size: 2.25rem;
}
}
/* end responsive fix for h1 */



/* byline/share sizing */
.share-this-intro, .article-author-prefix-2022 {
    font-family: 'IBM PLEX SEMIBOLD';
}
p.share-this-intro {
    font-size: 22px;
}
.article-author-prefix-2022 {
    font-size: 20px;
}

#st-1 .st-btn {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    height: 48px !important;
    line-height: 48px !important;
    padding: 0 12px !important;
}

#st-1 .st-btn>img {
    height: 24px !important;
    width: 24px !important;
    top: 12px !important;
}
/* end byline/share sizing */


.content-carousel—stack {
    padding-bottom: 50px;
}

.figure {
  text-align: center;
  width: 100%;
}

footer.footer {
  border-top: none;
}

h1 p {
  font-size: 3.5rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6 {
  font-family: var(--medium-weight-sans);
}

.newsArchive #selectYear {
  margin: 8px 0px 30px;
}

.pagination>a.currentpage {
  color: white;
}

.pull-content.card {
  margin: 0 2%;
  background-color: var(--dark-blue);
}

.pull-content .card-body p {
  color: white;
}

.pull-content .card-body p a {
  color: white;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.pull-content .card-body p a:hover,
.pull-content .card-body p a:focus {
  color: var(--cool-gray-3);
}

.filter-mobile {
    padding-left: 20px;
}

@media (min-width:768px) {
  .pull-content+.single-news-body {
    padding-top: 0%;
  }
}

.card.bg-gray{
  background-color: unset;
}
</style>

        padding-bottom: 80px;
        padding-top: 100px;
    }
}
@media (min-width: 1410px) {
    button.mobile-menu-toggle {
        display: none;
    }
}
</style><style>
.news-landing-header .news-hero-wrapper {
    min-height: calc(100vh - 365px);
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    align-content: stretch;
    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.news-hero-featured {
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: 50%;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding-left: 5%;
      padding-right: 5%;
      z-index: 99999;
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 300px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      text-decoration: none;
}
.news-hero-featured .featured-hero-link {
     display: flex;
     text-decoration: none;
     height: 100%;
     flex-direction: column;
     justify-content: flex-end;
 
}
.news-hero-featured .featured-hero-link-inner {
     transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
     position: relative;
     z-index: 999999;
}
.news-hero-featured h1, .news-hero-featured h2 {
    font-size: 48px;
    line-height: 40px;
    text-align: left;
    color: #fff;
    text-shadow: 0px 0px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.39);
    font-family: var(--semi-bold-sans);
}
.news-hero-featured h2, .news-hero-supporting h2 {
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}
.news-hero-featured p {
    font-size: 24px;
    line-height: 30px;
    text-align: left;
    color: #fff;
    transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
}
 .news-landing-header .news-hero-featured:before {
    content: "";
    height: 240px;
    background: linear-gradient(to top, #343741 0%, rgba(0, 17, 83, 0) 100%);
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: multiply;
}
 .news-landing-header .news-hero-featured:after {
    content: "";
    background-color: #0021a5;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    transform: translateY(101%);
    transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
    z-index: 9999;
    mix-blend-mode: multiply;
}

.news-landing-header .news-hero-featured:hover::after, 
.news-landing-header .news-hero-featured:focus::after,
.news-landing-header .news-hero-featured:focus-within::after {
    transform: translateY(0%);
}
.news-hero-featured:hover p,
.news-hero-featured:focus p, 
.news-hero-featured:focus-within p {
    visibility: visible;
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0%);
}
.news-hero-featured:focus-within::after {
  transform: translateY(0%);
}
.hero-link {
    display: flex;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 240px;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    text-decoration: none;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: 50%;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding-left: 5%;
    padding-right: 5%;
}
.hero-link .hero-link-inner {
    transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 999999;
}
.hero-link .hero-link-inner h2 {
    font-size: 30px;
    line-height: 40px;
    text-align: left;
    color: #fff;
    text-shadow: 0px 0px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.39);
    font-family: var(--semi-bold-sans);
}
.hero-link .hero-link-inner p {
    font-size: 24px;
    line-height: 30px;
    text-align: left;
    color: #fff;
    visibility: hidden;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
    transform: translateY(101%);
} 

 .news-landing-header .hero-link:before {
    content: "";
    height: 240px;
    background: linear-gradient(to top, #343741 0%, rgba(0, 17, 83, 0) 100%);
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: multiply;
}
.news-landing-header .hero-link:after {
    content: "";
    background-color: #0021a5;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    transform: translateY(101%);
    transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
    z-index: 9999;
    mix-blend-mode: multiply;
}
.hero-link:hover .hero-link-inner,
.hero-link:focus .hero-link-inner {
  transform: translateY(0px);
}
.news-landing-header .hero-link:hover::after,
.news-landing-header .hero-link:focus::after {
   transform: translateY(0%);
}

.hero-link:hover p,
.hero-link:focus p {
  visibility: visible;
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0%);
}
.hero-link:focus::after {
   transform: translateY(0%);
}
 .news-hero-supporting {
      display: flex;
      align-items: stretch;
      align-content: stretch;
      width: 100%;
} 
@media (min-width: 1261px) and (max-width: 1500px ) {
    .hero-link .hero-link-inner h2 {
      font-size: 28px;
      line-height: 35px;
    }
    .hero-link .hero-link-inner {
      transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
      transform: translateY(10px);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 999999;
    }
    
	.hero-link .hero-link-inner p {
      font-size: 20px;
      line-height: 25px;
    }
 } 
@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1260px ) {
    .hero-link .hero-link-inner h2 {
        font-size: 26px;
    	line-height: 28px;
    }
    .hero-link .hero-link-inner p {
      font-size: 20px;
      line-height: 20px;
    }
 } 
@media (min-width: 855px) and (max-width: 1054px) {
  .hero-link .hero-link-inner {
      transform: translateY(0px);
   }
 }  
@media only screen and (min-width: 1055px) {
     .news-landing-header .news-hero-wrapper{
       flex-direction: row;
      }
    .news-hero-featured {
       max-width: 66.66%;
      }
     .news-hero-supporting {
       max-width: 33.33%;
       flex-direction: column;
     }  

 }
 @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1054px) {
    .hero-link {
      height: auto;
      width: -webkit-fill-available;
    } 
     .news-landing-header .news-hero-wrapper{
        min-height: auto;
      }
 }   
 @media only screen and (max-width: 767px) {
   .news-hero-supporting {
     flex-direction: column;
   }  
   .news-hero-featured h2 {
    font-size: 40px;
   } 
   .news-hero-featured p {
    font-size: 20px;
   } 
   .hero-link .hero-link-inner h2 {
    font-size: 24px;
    line-height: 30px;
   }
   .hero-link .hero-link-inner p {
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 18px;
   }
   .news-landing-header .news-hero-featured:before {
    background: linear-gradient(to top, #343741 70%, rgba(0, 17, 83, 0) 100%);
   }  
    .hero-link .hero-link-inner {
      transform: translateY(0px);
   }
 }
 


@media only screen and (min-width: 1055px) {
    .news-hero-featured {
        max-width: 33.33%;
        padding-left: 3.33%;
        padding-right: 3.33%;
    }
}
@media only screen and (min-width: 1055px) {
    .news-hero-supporting {
        max-width: 66.66%;
        flex-direction: row;
    }
}
@media only screen and (min-width: 1055px) {
  .hero-link{
    max-width: 50%;
  }
}

.news-hero-featured h2, .hero-link .hero-link-inner h2  {
    font-size: 30px;
    line-height: 34px;
}

@media (min-width: 1055px) and (max-width: 1260px) {
    .news-hero-featured h2, .hero-link .hero-link-inner h2 {
        font-size: 26px;
        line-height: 28px;
    }
}
 
</style><style>

.news-col-hidden {
	display: none;
}

}
.news-landing-body {
	padding-bottom: 30px;
}

  font-family: var(--light-weight-sans);

  .filter-mobile-container {
      display:none;
  }
}
@media (max-width:600px) {
  .filter-container,
  #misha_filters {
      display:none;
  }

      margin-bottom: 150px;
  }

    margin: 30px;
  }
}
.grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-gap: 10px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(450px,1fr));
  grid-auto-rows: 20px;
}

@media (max-width:1450px) {
  .grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px,1fr));
  }
}
#dropdown-month,
#mobile-dropdown-month {
	display:none;
}

    margin: 30px;
}

all at once</div><div class="card-date">Wednesday May 6, 2026</div><div class="card-text">A single water sample can reveal DNA from animals, plants, fungi and even human waste, offering a rapid snapshot of ecosystem health.</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item health-science 2026 may news-col"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="/2026/05/hantavirus/" class="news-card-link"><img src="/media/newsufledu/images/2026/05/hantavirus-square-resized.jpg" alt="A rendering of hantaviruses" class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">What is hantavirus? Symptoms, transmission and treatment explained</div><div class="card-date">Wednesday May 6, 2026</div><div class="card-text">The rare viruses are usually transmitted by rodents</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item health-science 2026 may news-col"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="/2026/05/botswana-pharmacists/" class="news-card-link"><img src="/media/newsufledu/images/2025/05/Jim-and-Joyce-in-gator-gear-copy-Meta.jpg" alt="Botswana pharmacists" class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">In Botswana, two UF alums help expand community pharmacy internships</div><div class="card-date">Wednesday May 6, 2026</div><div class="card-text">Call it fate, call it luck. src="/media/newsufledu/images/2020/01/EQuIPD-Workshop-January-2020-Photos_13-2048x1362.jpg" alt="" class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">UF hosts teachers from across Florida for innovative STEM education training</div><div class="card-date">Friday January 31, 2020</div><div class="card-text">The Herbert Wertheim College of Engineering is using a $5-million grant from the U.S. Department of Education to teach K-9 educators how to use sensors and probes as a means of collecting and analyzing data in order to build core concept models for students.</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item campus-community 2020 january news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="/2020/01/coronavirus-update/" class="news-card-link"><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">Updated guidance on coronavirus</div><div class="card-date">Friday January 31, 2020</div><div class="card-text">With the World Health Organization declaring a global health emergency and the U.S. State Department warning people not to travel to China, the University of Florida is continuing to monitor the novel coronavirus in conjunction with local and state health officials.</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item life 2020 january news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="/2020/01/coronavirus-travel/" class="news-card-link"><img src="/media/newsufledu/images/2020/01/GettyImages-155439315.jpg" alt="A passenger jet takes off into a sunset or maybe a sunrise. " class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">Nationwide survey shows how coronavirus is impacting travel plans in the U.S.</div><div class="card-date">Thursday January 30, 2020</div><div class="card-text">Nearly 1 in 5 American travelers who have trips booked in the next three months have already changed their travel plans due to concerns of coronavirus.</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item campus-community 2020 january news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="http://explore.research.ufl.edu/the-creative-writing-life.html" class="news-card-link" target="_blank"><img src="/media/newsufledu/images/2020/01/MFA-Faculty-Camille-Bordas-2048x1365.jpg" alt="" class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">The Writing Life</div><div class="card-date">Wednesday January 29, 2020</div><div class="card-text">The University of Florida&rsquo;s creative writing program nurtures and pushes its graduate students.</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item health-science 2020 january news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/science/our-taste-for-bahamian-hutia-shaped-rodents-diversity/" class="news-card-link" target="_blank"><img src="/media/newsufledu/images/2020/01/hutia-photo.jpg" alt="A collection of small, aged rodent bones." class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">Hungry for hutia? Our taste for Bahamas&rsquo; &lsquo;most peaceable rodent&rsquo; shaped its diversity</div><div class="card-date">Tuesday January 28, 2020</div><div class="card-text">The Bahamian hutia, a large Caribbean rodent with a blissed-out disposition, presents a curious case study in how human food preferences can drive biodiversity, sometimes shaping it over 1,000 years.</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item campus-community 2020 january news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="/2020/01/coronavirus/" class="news-card-link"><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">University of Florida officials release guidance on coronavirus</div><div class="card-date">Friday January 24, 2020</div><div class="card-text">No cases have been reported at UF or elsewhere in Alachua County. UF officials are closely monitoring updates related to a novel coronavirus as a second confirmed case has been reported in the U.S. connected to an outbreak in Wuhan, China.&nbsp;</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item campus-community 2020 january news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="https://www.eng.ufl.edu/newengineer/cise/uf-engineer-testifies-before-u-s-house-committee-about-election-security/" class="news-card-link" target="_blank"><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">UF engineer testifies before U.S. House committee about election security</div><div class="card-date">Wednesday January 22, 2020</div><div class="card-text">Juan E. Gilbert, The Banks Family Preeminence Endowed Professor, testified as an expert witness regarding election security during a&nbsp;hearing&nbsp;by the House Administration Committee earlier this month.</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item health-science 2020 january news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/science/2019-shark-attacks-low-cookiecutter-bites-up/" class="news-card-link" target="_blank"><img src="/media/newsufledu/images/2020/01/1106300012.jpg" alt="A preserved shark lies on a table." class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">Shark attacks remained low in 2019 &ndash; but bites from the elusive cookiecutter were up</div><div class="card-date">Tuesday January 21, 2020</div><div class="card-text">Shark attacks were unusually low for the second year running, with 64 unprovoked bites in 2019, according to the University of Florida&rsquo;s&nbsp;International Shark Attack File.&nbsp;</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item campus-community 2020 january news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="/2020/01/uf-online-ranking/" class="news-card-link"><img src="/media/newsufledu/images/2020/01/Badge-OnlinePrograms-Bachelors-2020.png" alt="" class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">UF online programs see new gains in 2020 U.S. News &amp; World Report rankings</div><div class="card-date">Tuesday January 14, 2020</div><div class="card-text">University of Florida online degree programs saw new gains in the 2020 U.S. News &amp; World report rankings released today, with two of the four UF programs that were ranked climbing yet again and two others coming in among the best in the country.</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item health-science 2020 january news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/science/carib-skulls-boost-credibility-of-columbus-cannibal-claims/" class="news-card-link" target="_blank"><img src="/media/newsufledu/images/2020/01/Carib_indian_cropped-1.jpg" alt="" class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">Study puts the &lsquo;Carib&rsquo; in &lsquo;Caribbean,&rsquo; boosting credibility of Columbus&rsquo; cannibal claims</div><div class="card-date">Friday January 10, 2020</div><div class="card-text">Christopher Columbus&rsquo; accounts of the Caribbean include harrowing descriptions of fierce raiders who abducted women and cannibalized men &ndash; stories long&nbsp;dismissed&nbsp;as myths.&nbsp;A new&nbsp;study&nbsp;suggests Columbus may have been telling the truth.</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item agriculture-environment 2020 january news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/science/identity-of-florida-invasive-fish-corrected/" class="news-card-link" target="_blank"><img src="/media/newsufledu/images/2020/01/crutchfield2.jpg" alt="A small, black fish lies in a person's hand." class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">Fish switch: Identity of mystery invader in Florida waters corrected after 20 years</div><div class="card-date">Wednesday January 8, 2020</div><div class="card-text">Experts have mistaken the chanchita, Cichlasoma dimerus, for a look-alike invasive species, the black acara, in Florida for at least 20 years. Both species belong to the cichlid family, in which species can often be difficult to distinguish from one another.</div></div></a></div></div><div class="item campus-community   news-col-hidden"><div class="card news-card content"><a href="/2020/10/peace-corps-ranking/" class="news-card-link"><img src="/media/newsufledu/images/generic/azaleas-and-tower.jpg" alt="Blooming azaleas in front of Century Tower" class="card-img-top" /><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">UF ranked #3 among Peace Corps Prep Certificate-issuing Institutions</div><div class="card-date"></div><div class="card-text">UF recently ranked #3 among the 140 Peace Corps Prep certificate-issuing institutions in the nation, issuing 35 Peace Corps Prep certificates to the graduating class of 2020. There were 305 Gators enrolled in the Peace Corps Prep program during the 2019-20 academic year.</div></div></a></div></div></div></div><div class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-center button-wrapper mt-4">

<script>
	/*Get rid of empty container element in the Section Navigation of News category landing pages using the Tier 2/3 Template News Inner Page layout */
function removeEmptyContainer(){
  const sectionNav = document.querySelector("nav.section-navigation");
  const possiblyEmptyContainer = document.querySelector("li.current-page.dropdown ul.section-dropdown");
  const mainPath = '/news-categories/';
  const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
 
  if (currentPath.startsWith(mainPath) && currentPath !== mainPath) {
      if(sectionNav !== null) {
       possiblyEmptyContainer.remove();
    }
  }
}

removeEmptyContainer();
</script>

  // Ensure that text-only control buttons are in the right place
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const listExist = setInterval( () => {
    const parent = document.querySelectorAll('.card-container');
    
    parent.forEach(p => {
        const slickList = p?.querySelector('.slick-list');
        const nextButton = p?.querySelector('.cto-next');
        const prevButton = p?.querySelector('cto-prev');
         if(slickList && prevButton){     
            clearInterval(listExist);

            p.insertBefore(nextButton, slickList);
        	p.insertAfter(prevButton, slickList);
        }
    });
  });
}, 100);
</script>
